Name: Grass Spread Anywhere
Author: LilEGrin
Description:
Allows Grass to spread everywhere, including modded areas. By default all areas are off, use GMCM (settings > Mod Options) once you've loaded a save to configure.

Check if you want it to only spread on grassy, non-diggable tiles (default is spread everywhere)
Default growth rate of 15%
Check each area you want to enable grass spread.


Should have no compatability issues, works with SVE, East Scarp, Ridgeside Valley

Downloads.Description: Allows grass to grow anywhere, fully configurable
